messages:
Maria (CS): EBR with HorizonPay is scheduled Tue 4pm PT. Need final slide deck by Mon EOD. Main ask: propose renewal with a 10% price adjustment tied to SLA + feature bundle. Please help assemble: account health, onboarding status, usage trends, enablement plan, and a short renewal recommendation + risk heatmap. Exec alignment required before Tue morning.

Sam (CS Manager): Noted. I'll take account health + onboarding slides. Need DAU/MAU, top integrations, and any outstanding playbook items.

Lia (Analytics): I can pull usage trends and latency percentiles. Will deliver a CSV and quick charts by Fri 5pm.

Jon (Product): I'll draft the roadmap slide and map which asks tie to which features. Can someone share the top 3 product requests from HorizonPay? Also want a quick metric showing value (e.g., revenue per 1k calls).

Priya (EngOps): I'll own the enablement/training adoption slide. Quick Q — has HorizonPay completed SSO rollout? Last status I saw was partial.

Maria (CS): SSO is in progress (ticket #4237). Onboarding completion currently 78% — add that to the progress bar. @Simon (VP Customer) can you confirm who will own the renewal negotiation?

Simon (VP Customer): I will take point on exec alignment. I want to propose renewal tied to Q1 implementation milestones. I'll sync with revops for pricing approval. :thumbsup:

Lia (Analytics): Quick raw table (for slides) — I'll format charts after review:

```
metric,30d,90d
DAU,3200,2900
avg_tokens_per_req,420,400
p95_latency_ms,850,900
error_rate_percent,0.4,0.6
```

Sam (CS Manager): Good — call out two primary risks: SSO delay and p95 latency spikes during peak. I'll add mitigation notes and current status for each.

Jon (Product): Also add the fallback model we enabled last month — looks like a ~2% error reduction in production. I'll make a 1-slide visual for that.

Maria (CS): Action items (quick):
```
1) Lia: deliver CSV + charts (usage, latency, error) — due Fri 5pm
2) Sam: account health + onboarding slides — draft due Mon 9am
3) Jon: roadmap + feature-ask mapping slide — draft due Mon 12pm
4) Priya: enablement deck + adoption bullets — due Mon 12pm
5) Simon: exec alignment plan + pricing approval path — due Tue 10am
6) Maria: compile final deck + rehearsal — due Mon 3pm
```

Priya (EngOps): For enablement I will draft two success stories (short bullets) and training adoption stats. ETA Mon noon.

Simon (VP Customer): I'll join the slide review Mon 3pm PT. If deck looks good, I'll present the ask in exec sync Tue morning.

deploy-bot: Assets updated: https://redwood/internal/ebr/horizonpay/v2 — latest slides and raw exports uploaded.

Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — please ping if you can't hit deadlines. We only need small, focused slides. :pray:

Sam (CS Manager): Quick note — I'll add a single-slide appendix with outstanding tickets and owners.

Lia (Analytics): Uploaded charts to the folder; I'll DM the link.

Maria (CS): Perfect. See you for review Mon 3pm. :calendar:
